notes.title: Ready for a Challenge?
notes.notes:
Think you got what it takes? Challenge Yourself in the all new Box Maze Extreme with 30 crazy levels! More enemies and obstructions, checkpoints instead of saves. Box Maze Extreme is not for the faint-hearted. Includes FREE skins!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/818890/Box_Maze_Extreme/

notes.title: Patch Notes: 05/01/2017 / Full Release
notes.notes:
Hi Guys & Girls XD

The following has been added to BM2:

1. 15 brand new levels. (All 100 levels are now available)
2. 2 new secret levels. (10 secret levels are available to find in the game)

Full Release

BM2 is now ready for final release, we just want to test a few more things but once those things are tested BM2 will be fully released XD

Much Love
ABI7ITY & FAY

notes.title: Patch Notes: 03/10/2017
notes.notes:
Hi peeps.

[b] Bug fixes:[/b] 
1. Fixed a bug that was not allowing the "1st pizza collected" achievement to unlock.

[b]Changes[/b]
1. Updated the adverts for Box Maze 1 and Family Skins Pack discounts on the main menu.
2. Made Hidden Message Achievements 6 - 10 unlockable once completing level 49 (these few hidden messages have not been added to the game itself as yet but will be added during Early Access, we just want you to be able to unlock all the achievements at all stages on EA )

Much Love
ABI7ITY

notes.title: Small Launch Hiccups
notes.notes:
Hi Peeps :)

First of all thank you so much to the bunch of you who have already started playing the game :P

[b]Issues should now be fixed[/b]
[strike]We have some issues that we are fixing right now, mainly a couple of silly things like one naughty level that throws you back to the wrong level and some achievements not granting -_-

But do not fear! We are putting the boxes in place right now, we just finished shouting at them and very soon they will be fixed XD
So expect about a 120mb update in the next hour or so :)[/strike]

Thank you and sorry for any inconvenience.

Much Love
ABI7ITY

notes.title: 33% Discount | Trading Card News
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29790877/ecba23d96289beeb39e09902865a80a2cd72f82a.png[/img]

Box Maze 2 will launch on September 25th with a 33% discount.

We hope you enjoy Box Maze 2!

[b]Trading Card News[/b]
Trading card's will be in Box Maze 2 as soon as we reach the
"confidence metric " that Steam recently added, in short once Steam see's the game is actually being bought and played by genuine users they will allow us to release trading card's, this is a process all new game's need to go through but we will reach hopefully very quickly :)

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/1954971077935370845] For more information on this please click here[/url]

Much Love
ABI7ITY & Fay
